title: DuDuClaw CONTRACT.toml
description: Behavioral boundary definition for a DuDuClaw agent. See docs/spec/contract-toml-spec.md for full specification. Every key is optional: the parser (crates/duduclaw-agent/src/contract.rs) fills a missing key with an empty list or 0 and ignores keys it does not know.

boundaries.description: Core behavioral constraints. Optional; an absent section is an empty contract.

must_not.description: Patterns or substrings the agent must NEVER output. Supports glob wildcards (*, ?, [range]). Optional; defaults to an empty list.

must_always.description: Behaviors the agent must ALWAYS exhibit. Used for red-team testing and system prompt injection. Optional; defaults to an empty list.

max_tool_calls_per_turn.description: Maximum MCP tool calls per response turn. 0 = unlimited. Optional; defaults to 0.

browser.description: Ignored. Accepted so existing files stay valid; no code reads a [browser] section of CONTRACT.toml (the parser only reads [boundaries]). Browser and computer-use permissions are configured in agent.toml [capabilities].
